item.title: Цифровая фрагментация восприятия: влияние многозадачности и вертикального видео на линейное повествование
item.description: Актуальность исследования обусловлена глобальной трансформацией когнитивных привычек под воздействием цифровых медиа. Распространение коротких вертикальных видео и медиа-многозадачности меняет механизмы восприятия информации, что может подрывать фундаментальную способность человека к линейному, причинно-следственному мышлению. Цель статьи — на основе анализа существующих эмпирических исследований выявить механизмы цифровой фрагментации восприятия и оценить их влияние на обработку линейных повествований. item.title: Why Young Consumers Regret the Click: Attention Economy Interruptions and Micro-Regret in Social Media Marketing
item.description: The study investigates how social media notification design shapes young consumers’ emotional and behavioural responses across the dominant platforms of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Twitter. Extending affect infusion theory, interruption science and digital choice architecture, the research introduces and validates micro-regret as an immediate, interruption-induced emotional reaction that arises prior to cognitive message processing. Explainable Hybrid GRU–TabTransformer Learning with Cross-Attention and LLM-Assisted Interpretation for Stroke Risk Prediction
item.description: Early stroke risk prediction offers an opportunity for timely interventions and may help reduce the clinical burden associated with stroke. item.description: Abstract AI-driven neuromarketing combines behavioural theory, multimodal sensing, statistical inference and machine learning to explain how consumers allocate attention, experience affect and translate internal states into purchase-related decisions. item.title: X-Net: Hybrid Transformer–CNN Framework with Multi-Aspect Attention for Precise Colon Polyp Segmentation
item.description: Accurate localization of colon polyps plays a crucial role in the early diagnosis of colon cancer. In this paper, we propose a novel network architecture, X-Net, which integrates the Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) and EfficientNet-B0. We selected EfficientNet-B0 due to its optimized design and computational efficiency, enabling it to effectively capture fine-grained local features. item.title: Digital Multitasking and Self-Perceived Working Memory and Attention in First-Year Medical Students
Eye-Tracking Analysis of Visual Attention and Preference in Human-Created, AI-Generated, and Human–AI Co-Created Advertisements
item.description: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in advertising, yet its effects on visual attention and preference remain insufficiently characterized. This study compared human-created (H), AI-generated (AI), and human–AI co-created (HAI) advertisements using eye tracking and a forced-choice task. Thirty-nine participants completed 858 trials involving 22 advertisement pairs while gaze was recorded at 60 Hz.
